status: Exploratory development investigation; source ResNet is supervised and selected on official validation
patient_roles: Original 23597 one-record fitting patients, 2621 monitoring patients, 4626 validation patients; future unsupervised encoders use all 65110 fitting ECGs with patient-balanced sampling
representation_fitting_labels: None for scaler/PCA/nuisance regression/clustering/VAE/SimCLR; the frozen ResNet itself was trained with SHD
residualization: Ridge alpha10, fitting-only preprocessing, available clinical/context plus 48 simple and 79 ordinary covariance variables; not proof of statistical independence
temporal_features: 64 trunk temporal SDs, 64 normalized first-difference RMSs, 64 lag1 correlations; not QRS/ST/T-specific
PCA_sign: Largest absolute loading positive; never oriented by outcome
cluster_choice: Maximum training-monitor silhouette; no clinical outcome selection
primary_association: Available clinical/context spline adjustment plus log normalized RMS, I-III correlation spline and frozen ResNet logit; OR per fitting-patient score SD
primary_multiple_testing: BH across all 48 primary factor-endpoint coefficients: 3 spaces x 8 factors x 2 outcomes
secondary_association: Parsimonious age spline + five ECG variables + sex/year/context + log energy + I-III + frozen score, separate BH family; exploratory
unsupported_endpoints: Do not rank TR velocity unit-ambiguous flag or rare outcomes as validated discoveries
QRS_STT_gate: No clinical interpretation until delineation/axis estimates are independently validated; fixed R-anchored windows are exploratory enrichments only
PTB_transfer_gate: Native frozen ResNet requires authenticated source preprocessing; future explicitly invariant encoder needs trained checkpoint and compatibility validation. PTB ECG labels never serve as echo outcomes.
ranking: Continuous scores for bootstrap stability, adjusted effect and FDR, nuisance/artifact dependence, interpretability and feasibility; no novelty or clinical ranking from significance alone
test_policy: EchoNext official test and PTB fold10 not accessed
